title: record:path ticks a stage the record skipped — a contract type with no legal review shows 「审查中 ✓」 after approval
body:
Ruled: 6442747364 · letter A (with the current_user guardrail) · 2026-10-27T13:14Z

Filing class: ① user-visible defect (misleading status) — reach: public door, measured in a browser on the 18.1.0 Console with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main`. **Reader:** the UI lane (`record:path` renderer) and the spec owner of `RecordPathProps` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:2187`).

## Business reason
In a contract system, 「审查中 ✓」 reads as "legal reviewed this". hotclm order contracts (ORD) skip legal review by design and go straight to approval. Yet their page path shows 审查中 as a passed step. An auditor or a requester reading the page is told something that did not happen.

## Measured
ORD-2026-0017 (submitted → in_approval → approved, never `in_review`): the path shows 草稿 ✓ 已提交 ✓ **审查中 ✓** 审批中 ✓ **已批准**. The renderer ticks every stage before the current one by position. A stage takes only `value`, `label` and `terminal`; there is no way to say a stage applies conditionally or was skipped.

## Expected (either is enough)
- A per-stage predicate (e.g. `visibleWhen` over the record) so an app can drop 审查中 for a type that skips it; or
- the renderer reads the record's history and shows a skipped stage as skipped (grey, no tick), not passed.

Dedupe: objectstack issues (2,000 most recent) and archived objectui issues grepped for `record:path`, `skip`, `stage` + `path` — none.
